The Indian stock market is at a crucial crossroads. Will the Nifty rally 10% from current levels, or is another 10% correction on the cards?
In this analysis, we look at two possible scenarios for the market - a bullish case and a bearish case, each supported by three key economic and financial indicators that could influence the direction of the Nifty.
From GDP growth, inflation and interest rates to crude oil prices, US bond yields and foreign investor flows, these indicators could shape what happens next.
Six key metrics. Two possible outcomes. One market to watch.
